title: Real-time high-resolution neural network with semantic guidance for crack segmentation (HrSegNet)
mechanism: A high-resolution path kept throughout the network with a low-resolution semantic guidance branch injected into it, designed for cracks.
adaptation: Run as a crack-specific benchmark entry: 1-ch replicated, 512 px, 24 classes, our protocol and splits, no extra tuning.
min_experiment: Bench run under the protocol vs house PF; 5-fold CV crack IoU and relF1@2; as a score arm kill if CV crack IoU is below house PF minus 0.012. About 8 GPU-h.
prior_overlap: Partial overlap with R5 (more resolution, n.d.); the architecture itself never run.
evidence: R: CrackSeg9k 80.56 mIoU (B48), B16 78.43 mIoU at 182 FPS; Asphalt3k, Concrete3k.
